Chilean Penguins Wear Vests for Wound Protection

Researchers in Chile are using specially designed vests to aid the recovery of injured Humboldt penguins. These vests are intended to protect wounds and prevent the penguins from interfering with stitches as they heal. The initiative aims to improve the healing process for these marine birds.
